text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementHealthSwitching to This Healthier Version of Salt Could Save Around 3 Million Lives a YearYou can even make it at homeJCBy Jake Currie4:00 PM CST on November 5, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleWithout salt, you will literally die—but that doesn’t mean it’s good for you. Too many sodium ions in your bloodstream causes water to osmotically pour in, ratcheting up your blood pressure and stressing out your system. Of course, there are salt substitutes, like potassium chloride. Unlike sodium, potassium can help lower your blood pressure by facilitating water removal via the kidneys.
